### Observed differences

- In the later window, activities A14, A18, A21, A22, A23 moved from early positions (mean around 0.32 of the trace) to late positions (mean around 0.70), while A15, A16, A17, A19, A20 moved from late (mean around 0.63) to early (mean around 0.39). [POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007, POS008, POS009, POS010]
- The order between these two groups reversed: for example, A15 and A24 were always A24 before A15 before, and are now always A15 before A24; the same reversal appears for many pairs involving A14, A18, A21, A22, A23 with A15–A20, A24, and A28. [REL012, REL013, REL018, REL019, REL024, REL025, REL033, REL034, REL038, REL039]
- Outgoing transitions of A14, A18, A21, A22, A23 changed from always going to A24 to always going to A29. [DIR001, DIR005, DIR008, DIR009, DIR010]
- A28 and A39 swapped their successor sets: A28 now goes to the early group (A14, A18, A21, A22, A23) instead of the late group (A15–A20), and A39 does the opposite. [DIR011, DIR012]
- The elapsed time between consecutive completions around A40 halved: e.g., between A30 and A40 from about 1.0 hour to 0.5 hour; similar for A41–A40 and A43–A40. [TWAIT001, TWAIT002, TWAIT003]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a hypothesis that the process changed the order of two groups of activities: a group consisting of A14, A18, A21, A22, A23 now occurs after a group consisting of A15, A16, A17, A19, A20, A24, A28, whereas before it occurred before them. This is directly shown by positional shifts, order reversals in pairwise relations, and successor changes. The large number of control-flow items (69 vs 0.65 expected) and time items (3 vs 0.015 expected) makes chance an unlikely explanation. A competing explanation that the two groups are alternative paths is ruled out because co-occurrence remains high (e.g., A15 and A24 co-occur in all traces in both windows). A limitation is that the early group appears in only about 20% of traces, so the reversal is observed in a minority of cases, but it is consistent across many indicators.

Other differences: The timing between consecutive completions around A40 halved, indicating a separate change in timing. [TWAIT001, TWAIT002, TWAIT003]
